name: skewbench-cluster-validation
_notes: spark_version 16.4.x-scala2.12 is the newest LTS carrying Spark 3.5.x (3.5.2).
The UI default is now a Spark 4.x runtime, which would not be comparable to
the single-node results. This must be set explicitly.
runtime_engine STANDARD disables Photon. Photon is ON by default from DBR
9.1 upward; it changes the execution engine and would invalidate the
comparison, and roughly doubles the DBU rate.
cluster_log_conf uses a Unity Catalog volume. DBFS root is deprecated and
new workspaces are provisioned without it. Log delivery must be configured
BEFORE the cluster starts -- it cannot be retrofitted to a finished run.
node_type_id Standard_D4ds_v5 = 4 vCPU. 5 nodes = 20 vCPUs, which is a
smaller quota ask than 8-core nodes. If the DDSv5 family is quota-blocked
on a new subscription, fall back to Standard_DS3_v2 (standardDSv2Family is
autotermination_minutes 20 is a cost guard. Set it explicitly; the default
is not documented. Terminate manually when the run finishes, but wait ~5
minutes first so log delivery flushes.
